name: Header 71
definition: Set of characteristics related to the protocol.

MessageFunction.name: Message Function
MessageFunction.definition: Identifies the type of process related to the message.

ProtocolVersion.name: Protocol Version
ProtocolVersion.definition: Version of the acquirer to issuer protocol specifications.

ExchangeIdentification.name: Exchange Identification
ExchangeIdentification.definition: Unique identification of an exchange of messages between two parties.

ReTransmissionCounter.name: Re Transmission Counter
ReTransmissionCounter.definition: Number of retransmission of the message. Incremented by one for each retransmission.

CreationDateTime.name: Creation Date Time
CreationDateTime.definition: Date and time at which the message was sent.

BatchManagementInformation.name: Batch Management Information
BatchManagementInformation.definition: Information related to the batch and the collection to which the message belongs if any.

InitiatingParty.name: Initiating Party
InitiatingParty.definition: Unique identification of the partner that has initiated the exchange.

RecipientParty.name: Recipient Party
RecipientParty.definition: Unique identification of the partner that is the recipient of the message exchange.

TraceData.name: Trace Data
TraceData.definition: Information sent in the request message to be returned in the response one, for instance to help in the retrieval of the context of the exchange.

Traceability.name: Traceability
Traceability.definition: Identification of partners involved in exchange from the merchant to the issuer, with the relative timestamp of their exchanges.
